en.headline: Pope Leo submits mail‑in ballot for US midterm election
en.body: Al Jazeera reported that Pope Leo submitted a mail‑in ballot from Chicago ahead of the November 3 midterm elections. CNA also reported that the pope became the first pontiff to vote in a US general election.

it.headline: Il Papa Leo presenta una scheda di voto per posta per le elezioni di metà mandato negli Stati Uniti
it.body: Al Jazeera ha riferito che il Papa Leo ha presentato una scheda di voto per posta da Chicago in vista delle elezioni di metà mandato del 3 novembre. CNA ha inoltre riportato che il papa è diventato il primo pontefice a votare in un'elezione generale negli Stati Uniti.

fr.headline: Le pape Léon soumet un bulletin postal pour les élections de mi-mandat américaines
fr.body: Al Jazeera a rapporté que le pape Léon a soumis un bulletin postal depuis Chicago avant les élections de mi-mandat du 3 novembre. CNA a également signalé que le pape est devenu le premier pontife à voter lors d’une élection générale américaine.

de.headline: Papst Leo reicht Briefwahlstimmzettel für US-Zwischenwahlen ein
de.body: Al Jazeera berichtete, dass Papst Leo einen Briefwahlstimmzettel aus Chicago vor den Zwischenwahlen am 3. November eingereicht hat. CNA berichtete ebenfalls, dass der Papst der erste Pontifex war, der bei einer US-Wahl abgestimmt hat.

pt.headline: Papa Leo submete voto por correio para as eleições de meio de mandato dos EUA
pt.body: A Al Jazeera informou que o Papa Leo submete um voto por correio de Chicago antes das eleições de meio de mandato de 3 de novembro. A CNA também relatou que o papa tornou‑se o primeiro pontífice a votar numa eleição geral dos EUA.

ja.headline: 教皇レオが米国中間選挙の郵便投票を提出
ja.body: アルジャジーラは、教皇レオが11月3日の米国中間選挙前にシカゴから郵便投票を提出したと報じた。CNAも、教皇が米国総選挙で投票した初の教皇となったと報じた。

ko.headline: 교황 레오, 미국 중간 선거 우편 투표용지 제출
ko.body: 알자지르는 교황 레오가 11월 3일 중간 선거를 앞두고 시카고에서 우편 투표용지를 제출했다고 보도했다. CNA도 교황이 미국 총선에서 투표한 최초의 교황이 되었다고 보도했다.

es.headline: El Papa Leo presenta papeleta por correo para las elecciones de mitad de mandato en EE. UU
es.body: Al Jazeera informó que el Papa Leo presentó una papeleta por correo desde Chicago antes de las elecciones de mitad de mandato del 3 de noviembre. CNA también informó que el papa se convirtió en el primer pontífice en votar en una elección general de EE. UU.

zh.headline: 教皇利奥提交美国中期选举邮寄选票
zh.body: 半岛电视台报道，教皇利奥在11月3日中期选举前已从芝加哥提交了一张邮寄选票。CNA也报道，教皇成为第一位在美国大选中投票的教皇。

en.title: Pope Leo submits mail‑in ballot for US midterm election
en.dek: Pope Leo became the first pontiff to vote in a US general election by mailing a ballot from Chicago.
facts: Pope Leo submitted a mail‑in ballot for the November 3, 2026 US midterm election.
The ballot was mailed from Chicago.
Pope Leo became the first pontiff to vote in a US general election.
Al Jazeera reported the submission on 2026‑10‑31.
body: Pope Leo submitted a mail‑in ballot for the November 3, 2026 US midterm election. According to Al Jazeera, the ballot was mailed from Chicago. The submission was made ahead of the election day.

The act marks the first time a pontiff has voted in a US general election. According to CNA, Pope Leo became the first pontiff to cast a vote in a US election. The vote was for the midterm elections scheduled for November 3.
Pope Leo has been the head of the Catholic Church since 2024. He has previously participated in international diplomatic efforts. His decision to vote was announced publicly.
The US midterm elections will decide the composition of the House of Representatives and the Senate. The elections are scheduled for November 3, 2026. The ballot was mailed before the deadline.
Al Jazeera reported the event on 2026‑10‑31. CNA reported the event on 2026‑10‑30. Both outlets confirmed the pope's participation.
The Vatican has not issued an official statement regarding the vote. No official Vatican statement was found in the sources.
en.context: Pope Leo became the head of the Catholic Church in 2024. The 2026 US midterm elections will decide the composition of the House of Representatives and the Senate.
